caption: The drawing depicts a multi-story white building with a central arched entrance and a small tower topped with a spire and cross, which rises above the main roof. The building is seen through a symmetrical arrangement of tall trees with brown trunks and green, yellow, and blue foliage, their branches and leaves forming a canopy overhead. A paved stone pathway leads from the foreground directly toward the building's entrance, flanked on both sides by patches of green grass. On either side of the entrance, there are two small white structures partially visible near the outer edges of the image. Black iron fencing runs on both sides of the path, enclosing the grounds in front of the building, with portions of the fence winding behind the trees. The background sky is a gradient of light blue, with touches of white representing sunlight filtering through the treetops. The composition is vertically oriented, with tree trunks forming vertical lines that frame the building and lead the viewer’s eye toward the center structure.
title: New York City Hospital
